sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B Distills Opus Reasoning Into a Tiny GGUF Model
sources.snippet: Model overview Qwen3.5-2B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled-GGUF is a compact reasoning model built on the Qwen3.5-2B architecture and trained through knowledge distillation from Claude-4.6 Opus. The model learns to structure its thinking process using formatted <think> tags before generating final responses, enabling transparent step-by-step problem solving in a lightweight package. sources.title: Qwen3.5 2B Fine-Tuning Guide - distil labs
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 2B Fine-Tuning Guide Qwen3.5-2B is the newest small student in the distil labs catalog and the first at this size with a 262,144-token native context window. It is a reasonable pick when your inputs are long, and a speculative one otherwise: no published distil labs benchmark covers the Qwen3.5 generation yet.
